provenance: Captured 2026-11-28 from the npm platform packages @kilocode/cli-linux-x64 7.5.16 and 7.8.40, run as `kilo serve` in bwrap (scratch home, workspace outside any repository, random port, KILO_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1) against a scripted local OpenAI-compatible model that only answered text. agentList is the GET /agent response, each agent without its permission rules and prompt text; sessionUpdated is the first session.updated frame after a prompt that named the ask agent; promptNamingAgent is that prompt as sent and accepted. Only other change: capture directories became /fixture/workspace.

agentList.name: code
agentList.description: The default agent. Executes tools based on configured permissions.

agentList.name: ask
agentList.description: Get answers and explanations without making changes to the codebase.

agentList.name: debug
agentList.description: Diagnose and fix software issues with systematic debugging methodology.

agentList.name: explore
agentList.description: Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Use this when you need to quickly find files by patterns (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), search code for keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer questions about the codebase (eg. "how do API endpoints work?"). When calling this agent, specify the desired thoroughness level: "quick" for basic searches, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" for comprehensive analysis across multiple locations and naming conventions. Bash is limited to an allowlist of read-only commands. For required scripts, tests, or binary-analysis commands outside that allowlist, select an available agent whose permissions allow them while preserving the requested no-change scope.

agentList.name: general
agentList.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions and executing multi-step tasks. Use this agent to execute multiple units of work in parallel.

agentList.name: orchestrator
agentList.description: Coordinate complex tasks by delegating to specialized agents in parallel.

agentList.name: plan
agentList.description: Plan mode. Can only edit plan files; all other filesystem mutations are denied.
